title: Recover unresolved delivery intents retained after their native owner is deleted
outcome: An operator can inspect and safely reconcile retired-owner delivery intents without releasing uncertain canonical outcomes or permanently exhausting the sender-host pending bound.
acceptance: Retired-owner pending and unknown intents remain fenced from recreated sessions, and recovery consults canonical outcomes before terminal settlement or payload collection.
A supported operator recovery path handles retained committed/refused/abandoned outcomes; uncertain delivery is never treated as absent.
Regression evidence covers owner deletion with pending/unknown rows, same native id recreation, global quota accounting and recovery after restart.
